newsitem.title: UK: Rolls Royce,Mersey Docks unit wins big order.
newsitem.headline: Rolls Royce,Mersey Docks unit wins big order.

text.p: UK engineering group Rolls Royce Plc and a unit of Mersey Docks and Harbour Company have won a $155 million port terminal contract in Argentina.
The UK joint venture is between Rolls' materials handling business Clarke Chapman and MDHC's consulting division called Portia Management Services.
The venture has been named Clarke Chapman and Portia Port Services and will operate, maintain and develop an iron ore and coal import terminal and another steel products terminal.
The terminals are based at San Nicolas, north of Buenos Aires in Argentina and will be run on behalf of the major steel producer Siderar SAIC.
The 12 year operation and maintenance contract will be shared equally by the venture's partners.
Clarke Chapman will be also provide new equipment, upgrade existing equipment and arrange financing.
